questions.q: What does a Business Process Design (BPD) document primarily describe?
options: The technical build steps for an Oracle Integration Cloud process
The future-state business process end to end, in business terms, with who performs each step
The severity levels used for defect management
The bank account hierarchy only
questions.explain: A BPD narrates the future-state process end to end in business language, including process flow diagrams and the Oracle screen each step corresponds to.

questions.q: How does a Solution Design Document (SDD) differ from a BPD?
options: The SDD is only used for training materials
The SDD specifies exactly how each gap is technically resolved — the configuration or extension build
The SDD replaces the need for a configuration workbook
The SDD is written before requirements gathering begins
questions.explain: The SDD goes one level more technical than the BPD, specifying exactly how each configuration or extension gap is resolved, including inputs, outputs, and interfaces.

questions.q: Signing off the BPD and SDD serves as the exit criterion for which TCM phase?
options: Engage
Validate
Design
Transition
questions.explain: Signing off the BPD and SDD is the exit criterion for the Design phase and the entry criterion for the Configure phase — the phase gate introduced in Lesson 3.

questions.q: Who typically signs off the BPD, and who typically signs off the SDD?
options: Business Process Owners sign the BPD; the Solution Architect and Technical Consultants sign the SDD
Only Oracle Support signs both documents
Only the Executive Sponsor signs both documents
The Testing Lead signs both documents
questions.explain: Business Process Owners sign off the BPD (confirming the future-state process works for them), while the Solution Architect and relevant Technical Consultants sign off the SDD.

questions.q: What does Brightfield's Cash Management BPD and SDD together close out?
options: The project's Engage phase
The Design phase, opening the door to Configure
The Testing phase
The Hypercare period
questions.explain: Brightfield's signed BPD and SDD for Cash Management close out the Design phase and open Configure for that module.
